subject: Integrating Redwood tracing into Halo AI LangChain SDK
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@haloai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: eng+partnerships@haloai.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood tracing + LangChain SDK integration request

Hi Kimberly —

We built our orchestration on top of LangChain and are rolling out a tracing/telemetry integration so customers can correlate prompts with downstream observability. We evaluated Redwood's docs and want to explore a shallow integration: 1) include a lightweight trace shim in our LangChain wrapper, 2) emit token-level spans so Ops can view cost/latency back to the request, and 3) add a sample prompt-tooling guide for prompt engineers.

Attached is a short SOW (halo-integration-sow-v1.pdf) and a filled security questionnaire. Can your team support a proof-of-concept by end of July?

High-level asks:
- Minimal-footprint trace shim compatible with LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters
- Example instrumentation for prompt templates and retriever calls
- Notes on supported Redwood model variants and recommended quantization profiles for cost/latency tradeoffs

Available times for a sync this week: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT or Thu 2–5 PT.

Thanks — excited to collaborate.

Alex Rivera
Head of Partnerships, Halo AI
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@haloai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood tracing + LangChain SDK integration request

Alex —

Thanks for the clear brief and the SOW. We can take this to a POC level by end of July, provided we scope the first wave narrowly (LangChain shim + a short example repo). I've looped in Marissa (product/ISV) and Jonas (runtime) to scope technical work and acceptance criteria.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- Quick kickoff call to align scope and milestones (30m) — how about Wed 11:00 PT?
- We’ll review the SOW and security sheet; Jonas, please call out anything blocking for infra/access.
- Marissa, can you outline the sample prompts/templating guide we should ship with the POC?

Alex — I attached a link to a shared Drive folder and added the SOW. Also flagging that we typically recommend the following for initial POCs:
- Use a Redwood-hosted LangChain shim with token-level tracing disabled by default (opt-in)
- Provide a sample retriever instrumented with KV cache hints to show cost reductions
- Acceptance test: end-to-end demo that correlates a user query to per-token cost and a trace timeline

Kimberly Park
Head, ISV Alliances | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@haloai.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood tracing + LangChain SDK integration request

Alex / team —

Nice to meet you via email. A few technical clarifications from the ISV/product side so we scope the POC accurately:

1) SDK surface: do you want us to contribute a Redwood-backed "LangChainConnector" into your repo, or ship a drop-in pip package that Halo consumes? My recommendation for speed is the pip package (shim) plus a small reference repo showing how to wire it into LangChain/LlamaIndex flows.

2) Tracing depth: token-level spans are doable, but they add volume to telemetry. For the POC we should send summarized spans (per-step token counts + per-step latency) and allow customers to expand to token-level in their own environments. If Halo has a telemetry backend preference (Jaeger/Zipkin/Prometheus traces + events), let us know.

3) Prompt tooling: we can include a small prompts cookbook (5 patterns) and one automated eval harness (simple BLEU/ROUGE-style quality metric on canned prompts) to detect regressions.

I attached a tiny patch (redwood-sdks-trace-snippet.patch) with the shim prototype and a small README. Jonas: can you confirm runtime constraints (GPU vs CPU fallback, max batch size) and whether we can expose a "tracing-mode" flag at runtime?

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, ISV Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@haloai.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood tracing + LangChain SDK integration request

Quick engineering note and rollout plan: 

- Runtime support: We can instrument LangChain calls to emit spans to our tracing API with an opt-in config. Token-level exporting will be behind a sampling/opt-in switch; default telemetry will be per-step aggregates to limit cost.
- Backwards compatibility: The shim will detect LlamaIndex retriever calls and attach KV cache hints where available. No model changes required.
- Performance: On Dedicated capacity we can meet 95th percentile latency within your target if batch sizes are capped to 8 for the POC. We recommend quantized model variants for cost-conscious customers; we'll include recommended variants in the README.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: (1) demo that correlates 3 example queries to traces and per-step cost, (2) sample repo with README and tests, (3) security checklist items completed in the Drive.

Next actions:
1) Kimberly: confirm Wed 11:00 PT kickoff or suggest alternate time.
2) Alex: please confirm telemetry backend preference (default: send to Redwood demo collector) and share any compliance constraints from your security questionnaire.
3) I'll schedule infra tickets and a two-week engineering sprint to produce the pip package + sample repo.

Jonas Weber
Principal Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
